Tests that debugger correctly reflects receiver in strict and non-strict functions.
Strict tests:
Testing: Strict.call(undefined)
{"type":"undefined"}
Testing: Strict.call(null)
{"type":"object","subtype":"null","value":null}
Testing: Strict.call(1)
{"type":"number","value":1,"description":"1"}
Testing: Strict.call(1.2)
{"type":"number","value":1.2,"description":"1.2"}
Testing: Strict.call('asdf')
{"type":"string","value":"asdf"}
Testing: Strict.call(true)
{"type":"boolean","value":true}
Non-strict tests:
Testing: NonStrict.call(undefined)
{"type":"object","className":"global","description":"global"}
Testing: NonStrict.call(null)
{"type":"object","className":"global","description":"global"}
Testing: NonStrict.call(1)
{"type":"object","className":"Number","description":"Number"}
Testing: NonStrict.call(1.2)
{"type":"object","className":"Number","description":"Number"}
Testing: NonStrict.call('asdf')
{"type":"object","className":"String","description":"String"}
Testing: NonStrict.call(true)
{"type":"object","className":"Boolean","description":"Boolean"}
